title: Gap-aware fixed-M005 development reconstruction — 2015-2019 pilot
objective: Perform the first governed quantitative reconstruction of frozen M005 on verified OANDA 2015-2019 development-only evidence, preserving gaps as explicit censoring rather than synthetic continuity.
success_criteria: Bound RND-0032/RND-0033 evidence identities gate every evaluated shard
Frozen M005 uses MA20/MA50, vol12 ddof=0, threshold 0.0005, fixed sessions, one-bar delay and three-bar minimum hold
Signals use midpoint observations while execution uses real bid/ask closes
Any observed M5 discontinuity resets indicator and delayed-signal continuity
Any non-flat state encountering a gap is explicitly censored and contributes no completed-trade performance
Only 2015-2019 development evidence can produce strategy outcomes
Pair-level results expose completed trades, censored trades, costs, year attribution and evidence coverage
No portfolio sizing or cross-pair capital aggregation is introduced
stop_conditions: Any strategy search, tuning, ranking, Champion-filter evaluation or discovery
Any strategy outcome access for 2020 or later
Any validation or reserved-final-test signal/performance access
Any synthetic/interpolated/forward-filled candle or synthetic spread
Any silent indicator, delayed-signal or position continuation across a data gap
Any broker write, capital authority, automatic promotion or automatic merge
